D CORE 1GE SFP Module 10/100/1000BASE-T Copper RJ45 100M

The D CORE 1GE SFP Copper RJ45 Module delivers high-speed Gigabit Ethernet connectivity over standard Cat5e/6 copper cabling. Supporting 10/100/1000Mbps auto-negotiation, this hot-pluggable SFP module offers a convenient and cost-effective solution for short-distance network connections up to 100 meters. It has a standard RJ45 interface, making it ideal for switches, routers, and network interface cards (NICs) with SFP ports.

Key Features:

  • Data Rate: 10/100/1000Mbps (Auto-Negotiation)

  • Interface: RJ45 Copper

  • Distance: Up to 100 meters over Cat5e/6

  • Compatible with IEEE 802.3 standards

  • Hot-pluggable SFP form factor

  • Plug-and-play operation

  • Ideal for LAN, campus networks, and SMB environments

Get reliable and flexible copper connectivity with the D CORE 1GE SFP RJ45 Module, designed for stable Gigabit performance without needing fiber optics.
